nodes.name: checks.go
nodes.summary: Collection of policy check functions that decide whether a Certificate Secret and its CertificateRequests are current, valid, and correctly managed.

nodes.name: constants.go
nodes.summary: Defines the policy violation reason constants used by certificate policy checks and their human-readable meanings.

nodes.name: gatherer.go
nodes.summary: Gathers the Certificate, Secret, and current/next CertificateRequest state required to evaluate certificate policies.

nodes.name: policies.go
nodes.summary: Defines the policy input type, chain evaluation, and constructors for trigger, readiness, post-issuance, and temporary-certificate policy chains.

nodes.name: secrets.go
nodes.summary: Builds annotations and additional output formats (DER and combined PEM) for Secrets managed by a Certificate.

nodes.name: features.go
nodes.summary: Registers the cert-manager controller feature gates, including server-side apply, Gateway API support, and literal certificate subjects.

nodes.name: SecretDoesNotExist
nodes.summary: Fails when the Certificate target Secret does not exist.

nodes.name: SecretIsMissingData
nodes.summary: Fails when the target Secret is missing required certificate, private key, or CA data.

nodes.name: SecretPublicKeysDiffer
nodes.summary: Fails when the certificate and private key stored in the Secret do not form a valid key pair.

nodes.name: SecretPrivateKeyMismatchesSpec
nodes.summary: Fails when the Secret private key algorithm or size no longer matches the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: SecretKeystoreFormatMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when configured JKS or PKCS#12 keystores are missing from the Secret or do not match the password secret.

nodes.name: SecretIssuerAnnotationsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the Secret issuer annotations do not match the Certificate issuer reference.

nodes.name: SecretCertificateNameAnnotationsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the Secret is annotated as belonging to a different Certificate.

nodes.name: SecretPublicKeyDiffersFromCurrentCertificateRequest
nodes.summary: Fails when the Secret public key differs from the key recorded in the current CertificateRequest.

nodes.name: CurrentCertificateRequestMismatchesSpec
nodes.summary: Fails when the current CertificateRequest no longer matches the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: currentSecretValidForSpec
nodes.summary: Reports whether the current Secret data is complete and consistent with the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: CurrentCertificateNearingExpiry
nodes.summary: Fails when the current certificate has passed its renewal time.

nodes.name: CurrentCertificateHasExpired
nodes.summary: Fails when the current certificate is expired or has no parseable NotAfter value.

nodes.name: SecretSecretTemplateMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when labels or annotations from the Certificate secret template are missing or incorrect on the Secret.

nodes.name: certificateDataAnnotationsForSecret
nodes.summary: Builds the certificate detail annotations expected on a managed Secret.

nodes.name: secretLabelsAndAnnotationsManagedFields
nodes.summary: Decodes the managed fields covering Secret labels and annotations into a comparable structure.

nodes.name: SecretManagedLabelsAndAnnotationsManagedFieldsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when cert-manager managed fields for Secret labels and annotations are malformed or out of date.

nodes.name: SecretSecretTemplateManagedFieldsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the managed fields of the Secret do not reflect the current secret template.

nodes.name: SecretBaseLabelsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the standard cert-manager labels on the Secret are missing or wrong.

nodes.name: SecretCertificateDetailsAnnotationsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when certificate detail annotations on the Secret are missing or incorrect.

nodes.name: SecretAdditionalOutputFormatsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the additional output formats stored in the Secret do not match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: SecretAdditionalOutputFormatsManagedFieldsMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the managed fields for additional output formats do not match the Certificate spec.

nodes.name: SecretOwnerReferenceManagedFieldMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the managed owner reference field on the Secret does not match expectations.

nodes.name: SecretOwnerReferenceMismatch
nodes.summary: Fails when the Secret owner references do not match the owning Certificate.

nodes.name: mapsHaveMatchingValues
nodes.summary: Reports whether every key in one map exists with an equal value in another map.

nodes.name: Gatherer
nodes.summary: Interface for building policy input data for a Certificate.

nodes.name: DataForCertificate
nodes.summary: Collects the Certificate, its Secret, and the current and next CertificateRequests into a policy input.

nodes.name: Input
nodes.summary: Value object carrying the Certificate, Secret, and current/next CertificateRequests used by policy checks.

nodes.name: NewTriggerPolicyChain
nodes.summary: Builds the policy chain that decides whether a new issuance should be triggered.

nodes.name: NewReadinessPolicyChain
nodes.summary: Builds the policy chain that determines whether a Certificate is ready.

nodes.name: NewSecretPostIssuancePolicyChain
nodes.summary: Builds the policy chain that verifies a Secret after issuance.

nodes.name: NewTemporaryCertificatePolicyChain
nodes.summary: Builds the policy chain used when issuing temporary certificates.

nodes.name: AnnotationsForCertificate
nodes.summary: Builds the annotations describing a Certificate and its issuer for storage on the target Secret.

nodes.name: OutputFormatDER
nodes.summary: Encodes the private key in DER format for an additional output format.

nodes.name: OutputFormatCombinedPEM
nodes.summary: Concatenates the private key and certificate into a single PEM blob.
